name: Ports
author: reuk
description: What is listening on this machine, who owns it, and how far it reaches.

barWidget.description: Listening ports grouped into your processes, containers and system, with open, copy, stop and terminate.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Seconds between scans. Opening the panel always scans immediately.

schema.label: Icon alert
schema.description: When the bar icon turns the urgent colour. Never keeps it the same colour as the rest of the bar.

schema.label: Ignored ports
schema.description: Comma-separated ports or ranges to leave out, e.g. 53,631,8000-8010.

schema.label: Hidden names
schema.description: Comma-separated process, container, service or guessed names to leave out, e.g. spotify,kdeconnectd.

schema.label: Show system listeners
schema.description: List sockets owned by root or other users. Off shows only your processes and containers.

schema.label: Guess unnamed services
schema.description: Name sockets with a hidden owner after the service that usually uses the port.

schema.label: Include Docker
schema.description: Attribute published ports to the containers that own them.

schema.label: Include UDP
schema.description: List UDP sockets as well as TCP listeners.

schema.label: Confirm stop and kill
schema.description: Ask before terminating, killing or stopping. Off acts immediately.
